content.content: deccy log reads the set of nodes with their edges and lists it in dependency order; the verb changes nothing, records nothing, and settles no filtering.
content.rationale: The edges are the only order needed: every node's prerequisites are in the set itself, so the listing follows them without a second read. The order and its tie-break are ztpwplsn's to fix; this node keeps the read, the no-change restraint, and no filtering.
